reason: Aegis is a method pack for AI coding agents that emphasizes project-baseline analysis, architecture-aware planning, evidence-based verification, and controlled task execution across multiple hosts.

summaries.zh: Aegis 是一套面向 AI 编程代理的方法包，用于基于项目基线进行架构感知的规划、变更验证和任务执行。
summaries.en: Aegis is a method pack for AI coding agents that supports baseline-aware planning, architecture-informed changes, verification, and disciplined task execution.

capabilities: Provides workflow guidance for AI coding agents
Guides baseline inspection and architecture-aware planning
Encourages verification evidence before completion claims
Supports installation and updates across listed coding-agent hosts
